item.title: Europe to join U.S.-brokered Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, defying Kremlin objections
item.description: France says European officials will attend this week's U.S.-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, the first three-way round of negotiations since February.
item.content:encoded:
France says European officials will attend this week's U.S.-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, the first three-way round of negotiations since February.

(Image credit: Dan Bashakov)

item.title: No clear winner in New Zealand election, as leaders prepare for weeks of talks
item.description: Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, who will lead a caretaker government while negotiations take place, said: "I think everyone's over politics so let's all have a bit of a break for the next three weeks".

item.title: One air ambulance service rethinks what it takes to practice medicine in the sky
item.description: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.

item.title: A desert stirs to life: Chile's Atacama erupts in its biggest floral display in decades
item.description: El Niño rains have transformed Chile's Atacama Desert into a spectacular sea of color, awakening a fleeting ecosystem of flowers and wildlife in one of the driest places on Earth.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: How Gen Z voters helped fuel a blue wave for Democrats
item.description: Republicans made gains with young voters in 2024, but in this year's midterms Americans under 30 issued a strong rebuke of President Trump and his party, voting decisively for Democrats instead.

item.title: Homelessness in the U.S. saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year
item.description: Homelessness declined after years of record-high levels but it still remains at nearly 700,000. The Trump administration and homeless advocacy groups cite different reasons for the drop.
